summary: SEO Phase 2: Dynamic Content Silo Architecture - Pillar Pages testing complete. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend pillar pages load correctly with hero, content, sidebar, FAQ. Mobile responsive layout works. Blog article routes at /career-insights/:slug still functional.

integration_issues.issue: OG tags (og:title, og:description, og:url) and canonical URL not appearing in page head despite being in Helmet component. Title tag IS correctly updated from API data. Meta description shows static index.html value instead of API meta_description.
integration_issues.note: This is an SEO concern for social sharing but core page functionality works. May be react-helmet-async behavior with existing static meta tags.
